entities.name: Presidential Palace Historical Site
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Presidential Palace Historical Site, which is located in Hanoi, Vietnam, is the place where Ho Chi Minh lived and worked during most of his time as leader of North Vietnam, from December 19, 1954 until his death on September 2, 1969.
